title: SpaceX’s Stock Lockup Is Expiring. Prepare for a Bumpy Ride.
summary: On Thursday, employees and other insiders at Elon Musk’s rocket company will be released from their first stock “lockup” and can start selling some of their shares.
body_markdown: On Thursday, employees and other insiders at Elon Musk’s rocket company will be released from their first stock “lockup” and can start selling some of their shares.
